dex.entry: The resolved form of a wisp that survived the Hollowing's full pull and did not fall entirely dark — nor entirely light. It exists as a stable chimera, its body a sphere of coexisting radiance and void. Its presence calms both lit and hollow kin. A kin that resolved the game's central conflict in it

art.silhouette: Large orb-being, one hemisphere bright bone-white with a golden core, the other deep void-black with a violet inner light; a belt of crackling silver sparks rings the equator; two long pale tendrils drift like arms.
art.palette: Large orb-being, one hemisphere bright bone-white with a golden core, the other deep void-black with a violet inner light; a belt of crackling silver sparks rings the equator; two long pale tendrils drift like arms.
art.direction: A kin that resolved the game's central conflict in its own body — the reward for finding it feels earned.
